Round 316 (PERF-7, self-hosted fonts) is implemented inside the task's file grants. No STOP condition came up and the protected files are unchanged (11/11 hashes OK). I did not run any browser check, so the real-page behaviour is unproven until C runs its checks. Nothing was committed.

**What changed (40 entries, the exact list the task expects)**
- **B's sketch applied:** `root.tsx`, `app.css`, `studio-lab.tsx`, `fonts.css`, `self-hosted-fonts.test.ts` and the TH7 test file match the sketch copies byte for byte.
- **Font files:** the 25 woff2 files and 5 OFL licence files were copied into `app/assets/fonts/`. All 25 + 5 match their pinned sha256 hashes.
- **Notices:** a `## Fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)` section now follows the LAME section in `third-party-licenses.ts`. A new test group, TL10 (3 tests), checks it. I regenerated `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`; the only change is the new section (19 lines added, 0 removed).
- **Doc 229** is written in Georgian, with the 7 template headings.

**Checks I actually ran**
- **A-CLAIMS:** identical to B's HEAD output.
- **A-TYPE / A-LINT:** typecheck and lint both exit 0. Biome on my files shows only the 3 existing warnings in `root.tsx`.
- **A-UNIT:** the 16 covering test files pass 236/236 (B's 233 plus TL10). I re-ran them after my last text edit and they still pass.
- **A-MUTANTS:** B's 12 mutants give exactly the expected precheck output. My own mutant (removing one family from the notices) turns TL10 and the notices-file check (TL5) red.
- **A-REVIEW:** `code-reviewer` found no Critical, High or Medium issues. I fixed its two Low wording findings in the notices:
  - The text now says only the file names differ from Google's, because the files were renamed.
  - It now says the licence text "is in the repository", because the `.txt` files are not part of the build.

  I did not ask for a second review, since both fixes were Low and text-only.

The full test suite, build, `verify` and the browser checks belong to the gate and to C.

**Proposals for B (in sketch files I'm not allowed to edit)**
- **P1 (Low):** the FN4 test only checks the generic OFL header, so swapped licence texts would still pass.
- **P2 (Low):** the FN1 test only scans `app/**` code and CSS files, so `public/`, `vite.config.ts` and `.html` files could still name Google's font hosts unnoticed.
- **P3 (Info):** the TH7 file-name regex has an unescaped `.`, and TH7 only proves the dev href. Only C's FONT-NET/FONT-PRELOAD can show each font downloads once.
- **P4 (Info):** the two Noto font stubs are embedded as `data:` URIs, so a future CSP will need `font-src 'self' data:`.
- **P5 (Info):** doc 229's measurement table has no raw FCP and DCL columns, so its numbers can't be checked from the doc.
- **Architecture note:** none. The reviewer recommends keeping `fonts.css` as its own link rather than importing it inside `app.css`.

**What C checks next:** SOURCE-SCOPE, CLAIMS (expected differences in K2, K9 and K10), SKETCH-EQUAL, UNIT with the mutants, FONT-NET, FONT-PRELOAD, FONT-CACHE, FONT-PIXEL, FONT-GLYPHS, FCP, PERF-LOAD (run alone), NOTICES, DOC, and G316-AUTH on :5173. PERF-7 is not done until C passes it and the gate runs.

The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-316.md`.
